title: console-starter README's "Without a backend" section describes the pre-#4042 root route: `/` now redirects to `/login`, it no longer stops at the loading screen
body:
Out-of-scope finding measured while verifying #3528. Documentation drift only; nothing is broken.

## The claim

`examples/console-starter/README.md`, section "Without a backend":

> Measured with nothing listening on `:3000`: `/login` renders in full but cannot sign in, and `/` stops at the branded "Initializing application… / Connecting to data source" screen — the adapter never connects, so no route below it mounts.

## What it does now

Measured with nothing listening on `:3000`, dev server on a free port, headless Chromium on `http://localhost:5231/`:

```
HTTP status        : 200
#root innerHTML len: 2506
body.innerText     : "ObjectOS\nBuild powerful business applications, faster.\n\nThe universal
                      platform for enterprise data management, workflows, and analytics.\n\n
                      Sign in to your account\n\nEnter your email and password to continue\n\n
                      Don't have an account? Sign up"
```

`/` renders the **login** screen, not the "Initializing application…" one.

## Why

`examples/console-starter/src/App.tsx` says so itself — the root route was wrapped in `AuthenticatedRoute` by #4042:

```
{/* `RootRedirect` resolves the landing from metadata, so it needs a
  * session. Guarded (not a bare `ConnectedShell`) so an
  * unauthenticated visitor goes to /login instead of firing a round
  * of doomed 401 `/meta/*` reads first — objectui#4042. */}
```

So an unauthenticated visitor is sent to `/login` before `RootRedirect` (and the loading screen behind it) ever mounts. The README paragraph was measured before that change and was not revisited with it.

The "Initializing application… / Connecting to data source" screen is presumably still what an *authenticated* session with a dead backend sees; that half was not re-measured here, so whoever fixes this should check it rather than assume, and consider whether the same paragraph in `apps/console`'s docs has the same drift.

Not folded into #3528's PR: that card is about the vite alias table, and this sentence is wrong for an unrelated reason (#4042), so correcting it there would have mixed two causes under one `Fixes`.
